newsitem.title: LATVIA: RTF, Daugavpils dominate quieter Latvia bourse.
newsitem.headline: RTF, Daugavpils dominate quieter Latvia bourse.

text.p: Shares in Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) and the Daugavpils chain manufacturer dominated the Latvian bourse on Wednesday, taking the limelight from leading bank Unibanka.
Overall market turnover was a low 87,203 lats, versus Tuesday's 169,000 lats.
RTF, on the official list, turned over 33,950 lats and rose to 1.09 lats from 1.07. Unibanka traded a low 6,272 lats and gained slightly to two lats from 1.95.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils saw activity of 28,969 lats and rose to 1.30 lats from 1.27.
Another active stock was the Salacgriva '95 company, which traded 7,700 lats of shares and rose to 2.39 lats from 2.08.
Fish cannery Kaija was unchanged at 1.30 lats on trade of 3,914 lats while bourse newcomer Lode Brick company fell to 95 santimes from 99 on trade of 3,873 lats.
